3.1: Yahweh, I have many enemies ! There are many people who oppose/rebel against me.

I said [to myself], “I will confess to Yahweh the wrong things that I have done.” And [when I confessed them], you forgave me, so now I ◄am no longer guilty/will no longer be punished► for my sins.

33.1: You righteous people should sing joyfully to Yahweh because that is what he deserves.

33.4: Yahweh always does what he says that he will do; we can trust that everything that he does is right.

33.14: from where he rules , he looks down on all the people who live on the earth.

33.20: We trust that Yahweh will help us; he protects us like a shield protects a soldier .
33.21: We rejoice because of what he [has done for us]; we trust in him because he is holy.

34.1: I will always thank Yahweh; I will constantly praise him .
34.2: I will boast about what Yahweh [has done]. All those who are oppressed/discouraged should hear me and rejoice.

34.4: I prayed to Yahweh, and he ◄answered my prayer/did what I asked him to do►; he rescued me from [all those who caused me] to be afraid.

34.8: Find out for yourself, and you will experience that Yahweh is good to you! He is very pleased with those who ask him to protect them.
34.9: All you who belong to him, revere him! Those who do that will always have the things that they need .
34.10: Lions [are usually] very strong, [but sometimes] even young lions are hungry and become weak, but those who trust in Yahweh will ◄have everything/not lack any good thing► [that they need].
34.11: You ◄who are my students/whom I teach►, come and listen to me, and I will teach you how to revere Yahweh.
34.12: If any of you wants to enjoy life and have a good long life,
34.13: do not say anything that is evil! Do not tell lies!
34.14: Turn away from doing evil, and do what is good! Always try hard to enable people to live peacefully [with each other.]
34.15: Yahweh carefully watches over those who [act] righteously; he always responds to them when they call [to him for help].
34.16: But Yahweh ◄is opposed to/turns away from► those who do what is evil. [And after they die], people will forget them completely.

35.1: Yahweh, fight against those who fight against me! Fight against [my enemies] when they fight me!
35.2: Be [like] a shield to protect me and come to help me!
35.3: Lift up your spear and [throw it] at those who pursue me! Promise me that you will enable me to defeat [my enemies].
35.4: Cause those who are trying to kill me to be defeated and disgraced! Cause those who are planning to do evil things to me to be pushed back and become confused!
35.5: Send your angel to pursue them, and as a result cause them to disappear like chaff/straw blown away by the wind!
35.6: Cause the path on which they run to be dark and slippery as your angel pursues them!
35.7: Although I did not do anything wrong to them, they concealed a deep pit for me to fall into; they hid a net in which they would catch me.
35.8: Cause them to suddenly experience disaster! Cause them to be trapped in their own nets! Cause them to fall into the pits that they have dug for me and disappear!
35.9: Then I will be joyful about what you, Yahweh, have done for me, I will be glad that you have rescued me.
35.10: With my whole inner being I will say, “There is no one like Yahweh ! No one else can rescue helpless people from powerful people . No one else can rescue weak and needy people from those who want to rob them.”
35.11: People who tell lies stand in court and falsely accuse me of doing things that I do not know [anything] about.
35.12: In return for my doing good things for them, they do evil things to me, with the result that I feel that I am alone.
35.13: When they were ill, I showed that I was sad. I did not eat any food, and I bowed my head as I prayed [for them].
35.14: I mourned and bowed my head as I prayed as though it was a friend or my mother for whom I was grieving.
35.15: But when I had troubles, they were all happy about it. They gathered around to make fun of me. Strangers struck me, and they would not stop.
35.16: Worthless people ridicule me and snarl at me.
35.17: Yahweh, how long will you only watch them doing this? Rescue me from their attacking me; Save me from being killed by these men who are attacking me like lions [that are attacking other animals]
35.18: Then, when many of your people gather, I will praise you and I will thank you in front of all of them.
35.19: Do not allow my enemies, who tell lies about me, defeat me and then rejoice! Do not allow those who hate me when there in no reason to hate me to ◄smirk/smile happily►!
35.20: They do not talk peacefully to people; instead, they seek ways to tell lies about people who are peaceful.
35.21: They shout at me, to accuse me, saying, “We saw the wrong things that you did!”
35.22: Yahweh, you have seen these things, so do not be silent! Do not stay far from me!
35.23: Arise, my God, and plead my case in court, and successfully defend me!
35.24: Yahweh, my God, because you are righteous, prove that I am innocent in order that my enemies will not be able to gloat [that I was judged to be guilty].
35.25: Do not allow them to be able to say to themselves, “Yes, we have gotten rid of him just like we desired!”
35.26: Cause those who rejoice about my misfortunes to be completely defeated and disgraced; cause those who boast that they are much greater than me to be disgraced and dishonored!
35.27: But cause those who desire that I be acquitted to be happy and shout joyfully, and cause them to continually say, “Yahweh is great! He is delighted to cause things to go well for those who serve him.”
35.28: Then I will proclaim that you act righteously, and I will praise you all day long.

36.1: [Wicked people continually desire to] sin. They consider that they do not need to revere God.
36.2: Because they are very proud, they do not think that God will discover their sins and condemn them (OR, they do not think about their sins and hate themselves for it).
36.3: [Everything] that they say is deceitful and full of lies; they no longer do what is good and are no longer wise.
36.4: While they are lying on their beds, they plan to do things to harm [others]; they are determined to do things that are not good, and they never refuse [to do what is] evil.
36.5: Yahweh, your faithful love for us reaches as high as the heavens, you faithfully [do what you have promised]; [it is as though your doing that] extends up to the clouds.
36.6: Your righteous behavior is [as permanent as] the highest mountains , your acting justly [will continue as long as] the deepest oceans [exist]. You take care of people and you take care of animals.
36.7: God, your faithful love for us is very precious. You protect us like birds protect their baby birds under their wings .
36.8: You provide for us plenty of food from the abundant supply that you have; your great blessings for us [flow] like a river.
36.9: You are the one who causes everything to live; your light is what enables us to see.
36.10: Continue to faithfully love those who have experienced a relationship with you, and bless those who act righteously/justly.
36.11: Do not allow proud people to attack me, or allow wicked people to chase me away.
36.12: Look where evil people have fallen on the ground, defeated; they were thrown down, and they will never rise again.

37.1: Do not be bothered/upset by what wicked [people do]. Do not desire to have the things that people who do wrong/evil have,
37.2: because they will soon disappear, like grass withers [in the hot sun] and dries up. Just like some green plants [come up but] die [during the hot summer], evil people will soon die also.

37.4: Be delighted with all that Yahweh [does for you]; if you do that, he will give you the things that you desire most.
37.5: Commit to Yahweh all the things that you plan to do; trust in him, and he will do [whatever is needed to help you].
37.6: He will show [as clearly] as the sunlight that you ◄are innocent/have done nothing that is wrong►; he will show [as clearly] as [the sun at] noontime that all the things that you have decided are just.
37.7: Be quiet in Yahweh’s presence, and wait patiently for him [to do what you want him to do]. Do not be bothered/upset when what evil men do is successful, when they are able to do the wicked things that they plan.

37.10: Soon the wicked will disappear. If you look for them, they will be gone.

37.12: Wicked people plan to harm righteous/godly people; they snarl at them [like wild animals].
37.13: But Yahweh laughs [at them] because he knows that some day [he will judge and punish] the wicked people.

37.16: It is good to be righteous/godly even if you do not have many possessions, but it is bad to be wicked, even if you are very wealthy,
37.17: because [Yahweh] will completely take away the strength of wicked people, but he will ◄sustain/take care of► people who live righteously.

37.20: But wicked people will die; [just] like the beautiful wild flowers in the fields [die under the hot sun] and disappear like smoke , Yahweh [will cause] his enemies to suddenly disappear.

37.27: Turn away from [doing] evil, and do what is good. If you do that, you [and your descendants] will live in your land forever.

37.30: Righteous people give wise [advice to others], and they say what is just/fair.
37.31: They continually think about God’s laws; they do not stray from [God’s] path.
37.32: Those who are evil wait in ambush for righteous people in order to kill them [as they walk by].

37.34: Be patient and trust that Yahweh [will help you], and ◄walk on his paths/do what he wants you to do►. [If you do that], he will honor you by giving you the land [that he promised], and when he gets rid of the wicked, you will see it happen.

39.13: [Now] please leave me alone, [and do not punish me any more] in order that I may smile and be happy for a while before I die. [EUP, DOU]”

40.1: I waited patiently for Yahweh [to help me], and he listened to me when I called out to him.

40.3: He has given me a new song to sing, a song to praise him who is our God. Many people will find out [what he has done for me], and they will revere and trust him.
40.4: Yahweh is pleased with those who trust him, those who do not trust in idols or join with those who worship those false gods.
40.5: O Yahweh, my God, you have done many wonderful things! No one can list all the wonderful things that you have planned for us. If I tried to tell [others] about all those wonderful things, I would not be able to, because there would be too many for me to mention.
40.6: Various kinds of sacrifices and other offerings are not the [only] things that delight you. You have enabled me to understand that very well . [Animals] burned [on the altar] and [other] offerings are not all that you require [for sins to be forgiven].
40.7: So I said [to you], “Yahweh, here I am, [to do] the things that have been written in the scroll [that contains your laws], things that you want me [to do].”
40.8: O my God, I delight to do what you desire; I [keep] your laws within my inner being.
40.9: Whenever all [your people] are gathered, I have told them about how you save us. Yahweh, you know that I have not been afraid to tell that to them.
40.10: And I have not kept to myself the news that you always act justly/fairly; when many of your people have gathered together [to worship you in the temple], I have told them that you are faithful to us and save us. I have ◄not concealed/openly told people► that you faithfully love us and act loyally toward us.
40.11: Yahweh, do not stop being merciful to me. Because you faithfully love [me] and are loyal [to me], always protect me.
40.12: I have many troubles; [so many that] I cannot count them. My sins are like a flood that has covered me [PRS, MET]; [they are so many that] I cannot find my way. The sins that I have committed are more than the hairs on my head. I am very discouraged.
40.13: O Yahweh, please save me! Come quickly to help me!
40.14: Humble those who are happy about my troubles, and cause them to be disgraced and ashamed. Chase away those who are trying to get rid of me.
40.15: I hope/desire that those who make fun of me will be dismayed when you defeat them.
40.16: But I hope that all those who go to [worship] you will be very joyful . I want those who love you because you saved them to shout repeatedly, “Yahweh is great!”
40.17: As for me, I am poor and needy ; but [I know that] Yahweh has not forgotten me. O my God, you are the one who saves and helps me, so please come quickly [and help me!]

41.1: Yahweh is pleased with those people who help to provide for the poor; he will rescue those people when they have troubles.
41.2: Yahweh protects them and allows them to live [for a long time]. He enables them to be happy in the land [of Israel], and rescues them from their enemies.
41.3: When they are sick, Yahweh strengthens them, and he heals them.
41.4: [When I was sick], I said, “Yahweh, be merciful to me and heal me; [I know that I am sick because] I have sinned against you.”
41.5: My enemies say cruel things about me; they say, “How soon will he die, and then everyone will forget about him ? (OR, he will not have [any descendants to continue] his name).”
41.6: When my enemies come to me, they falsely say that they [are concerned about me]. They listen to bad news about ◄me/my health►. Then they go away and tell everywhere what is happening to me.
41.7: All those who hate me whisper to others about me, and they hope/desire that very bad things will happen to me.
41.8: They say, “He will soon die because of his being sick; he will never get up from his bed [before he dies].”
41.9: Even my best friend, whom I trusted very much, who [often] ate with me, has ◄betrayed me/put me into my enemies’ hands► .
41.10: But Yahweh, be merciful to me, and enable me to become healthy [again]. When you do that, I will be able to ◄pay back my enemies/get revenge on my enemies/cause my enemies to suffer like they caused me to suffer►.
41.11: [If you enable me to] do that, with the result that my enemies do not defeat me, I will know that you are pleased with me.
41.12: [I will know that] it is because I have done what is right that you have helped me, and [I will know that] you will let me be with you forever.
41.13: Praise Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis [worship]; Praise him forever! Amen! I desire that it will be so!

42.1: Deer pant, desiring to drink water from a stream [when there is a drought] (OR, [when they are being pursued by hunters].) In the same way , God, I need you very much.
42.2: I desire to have fellowship with you, the all-powerful God. [I wonder], “When will I be able to go [back to the temple in Israel] and worship in your presence again?”
42.3: Every day and every night I cry; [it is as though] the only thing I have to drink is my tears; and while I do that, my enemies are continually asking me, “Why does your god not [help you]?”
42.4: I am very distressed as I remember when I went with the crowd of people to the temple [in Jerusalem], leading them as we walked along; we were all shouting joyfully and singing to thank God [for what he had done]; we were a large group who were celebrating.
42.5: So [I say to] myself, “◄Why am I sad and discouraged?/I should not be sad and discouraged!► I confidently expect God [to help me], and again I will praise him, my God, the one who saves me.”
42.6: [But now, Yahweh], I am very discouraged , so I think about you, even from where the Jordan [River] gushes out from the bottom of Hermon [Mountain] and from Mizar Mountain.
42.7: But here, the great sorrow that I feel is like water that you send down ; [it is like] a waterfall that tumbles down and floods over me.
42.8: Yahweh shows me each day that he faithfully loves me, and each night I sing to him and pray to him, the God who causes me to live.
42.9: I say to God, [who is like] an [overhanging] rock [under which I can hide] , “It seems that you have forgotten me. I constantly because my enemies act cruelly toward me” .

43.1: God, declare that I ◄am innocent/have not done things that are wrong►. Defend me when ◄ungodly people/people who do not worship you► say things against me, rescue me from people who deceive and [say things about me that are] not true.

44.1: God, we ourselves have heard what our parents and grandparents told us. They told us about the miracles that you performed long ago.
44.2: [They told us] how you expelled the ungodly people and enabled us to live in their land. [They told us] that you punished those ungodly people and enabled your own people to prosper .
44.3: It was not by using their own swords that they conquered the people that lived in that land, and it was not by their own power that they were victorious; it was only by your power [MTY, DOU] [that they did those things]; and they were sure that you were with them, and that showed that you were pleased with them.
44.4: You are my King and my God; it is you who enable us, your people , to defeat our enemies.

44.6: I do not trust that I will be saved by using my bow [and arrows] and my sword.

44.9: But [now] you have rejected us and caused us to be disgraced; when our armies march out [to fight a battle], you no [longer] go with them.

44.11: You have allowed us to become like sheep that were ready to be slaughtered; you scattered us [far away] among [other ]nations.
44.12: [It is as though] you sold us, your people, [to our enemies] for a very small price, and you did not gain much profit from selling us!
44.13: People who live in nations near us make fun of us; they laugh at us and deride/belittle us.

44.16: I hear what those who sneer at me and revile me say; I am ashamed in front of my enemies and those who want to harm me.
44.17: All these things have happened to us [even] though we have not forgotten you, and we are not the ones who disobeyed the agreement you made with [our ancestors].
44.18: We have not stopped being loyal to you, and we have not stopped doing what you want us to do .
44.19: But [it is as though] you have allowed us to be helpless among wild animals, and abandoned us in a deep dark [ravine].
44.20: If we had forgotten to worship our God, or if we had spread out our hands to [worship] a foreign god,
44.21: you certainly would have known that, because you know [even] what we secretly think.
44.22: But it is because we belong to you, [that our enemies] are constantly killing us. They act toward us as though we were only sheep to be slaughtered.
44.23: [So], Yahweh, arise! Why are you asleep ? Get up! Do not reject us forever!
44.24: Why are you not looking at us? Why are you forgetting that we are suffering and being oppressed [by our enemies]?
44.25: We are pushed down to the ground and we cannot get up.
44.26: Arise, and come and help us! Rescue us because you faithfully love us!

45.1: In my inner being I am stirred by a beautiful message which will be sung to the king. The words of this message will be written with a pen by me, a skilled writer.
45.2: [O King], you are the most handsome man in the world, and you always speak eloquently, because God has always blessed you.
45.3: You who are a mighty warrior, put on your sword! You are glorious and majestic.
45.4: Ride on like a great chief to defend the truth that you speak and the fair decisions that you make! Because you are strong , you will do awesome deeds.
45.5: Your arrows are sharp, and they pierce the hearts of your enemies. Soldiers of many nations will fall dead at your feet.
45.6: The kingdom that God will give to you will remain forever. You rule people justly.
45.7: You love right actions, and you hate evil actions. Therefore God, your God, has chosen you [to be king] and caused you to be happier than any other king.
45.8: The perfume of various spices is on your robes. [People] ◄entertain you/make you happy► in ivory palaces by playing stringed instruments.
45.9: Among the women who stay near you stay are daughters of [other] kings. And at your right hand stands [your bride], the queen, wearing beautiful ornaments of gold that comes from Ophir.
45.10: [Now I will say something] to your bride: Listen to me carefully ! Forget the people who live in your home country, forget your relatives!
45.11: Because you are [very ]beautiful, the king will desire [to sleep with] you. He is your master, so you must obey him.
45.12: The people from Tyre [city] will bring gifts to you; their rich people will try to persuade you to do favors for them.
45.13: [O king], your bride will be entering the palace wearing beautiful robes made from gold thread.
45.14: While she is wearing a gown that has many colors, her companions will lead her to you. She will have many other young women who accompany her.
45.15: They will be very joyful as they are led along to enter your palace.
45.16: Some day, your sons and your grandsons will become kings, just like your ancestors were. You will enable them to become rulers in many countries .
45.17: And as for me, I will enable people in every generation to remember the great things that you have done, and people will praise you forever.

46.1: God is the one who protects us and causes us to be strong; he is always ready to help us when we have troubles.
46.2: So, even if the earth shakes, we will not be afraid. Even if the mountains fall into the middle of the sea,
46.3: and if the water in the sea roars and foams, and the hills shake violently, we will not be afraid! (Think about that!)
46.4: [Blessings that come from] God are like a river that makes everyone in the city where [we worship] God joyful. It is the city where the temple of God, who is greater than any other god, exists.
46.5: God is in this city, and it will never be destroyed; he will [come to] help [the people in] that city at dawn every day.
46.6: [Sometimes] the [people of many] nations are terrified; kingdoms ◄are overthrown/cease to exist►; God speaks [loudly like thunder], and the earth melts (OR, people everywhere become terrified) .

46.8: Come and ◄see/think about► the amazing things that Yahweh has done !
46.9: He stops wars all over the world; he breaks bows [and arrows]; he destroys spears; he burns up shields.

46.11: [So never forget that] Yahweh, the commander of the armies of heaven, is with us; the God whom Jacob worshiped (OR, we Israeli people worship) is our refuge. (Think about that!)

47.1: You people all [over the world], clap your hands for joy! Shout joyfully to [praise] God!
47.2: Yahweh, who is much greater than any other god, is awesome; he is the king who rules over all the world!
47.3: He enabled us to defeat [the armies of] the people-groups [that lived in Canaan].
47.4: He chose for us this land where we now live; we Israeli people , whom he loves, are proud that we own this land. (Think about that!)
47.5: God has gone up [into his temple]. The people shouted joyfully and blew trumpets as Yahweh went up.
47.6: Sing songs to praise our God! Sing to praise him ! Sing to God, our king!
47.7: God is the one who rules over everything in the world; sing a psalm to him!
47.8: God sits on his sacred throne as he rules over the people of [all] ethnic groups.
47.9: The rulers of those people-groups gather as God’s people, the people [descended] from Abraham, [do]. But God has more power than the weapons/shields [of all the kings] on the earth; ◄he is greatly honored/people honor him► everywhere.

48.1: Yahweh is great, and he deserves to be greatly praised in the city where he [lives], [which is built on Zion], his sacred hill.
48.2: That city, on a high [hill], is beautiful; it is the city where the true [God], the great king, [lives], and it causes people all over the world to rejoice [when they see it].
48.3: God is in the strong towers there, and he shows that he protects the people in that city.
48.4: Many kings gathered [with their armies] to attack [that city],
48.5: but when they saw it, they were amazed; they became terrified, and ran away.
48.6: Because they were very afraid, they trembled like a woman who is about to give birth to a child;

48.12: [You Israeli people should] walk around Zion [Hill] and count the towers there;
48.13: notice the walls there and examine the forts in order that you can tell about them to your children.
48.14: [Say to them], “This is [the city that belongs to] our God, [the one who lives] forever; he will guide us all of our lives.”

49.1: You people of all ethnic groups, listen! You people all over the world,
49.2: important people and unimportant people, rich people and poor people, everyone, [listen to what I am saying],

49.9: with the result that he will live forever and never [die and] be buried!

49.12: Even if people are great, that cannot prevent them from dying; all people die, the same as animals do.
49.13: That is what happens to those who foolishly trust [in what they have accomplished], to those who are delighted in [all] that they possess. (Think about that!)

[PRS, MET] In the morning righteous people will rule over them, and then [those wealthy people will die and] their bodies will quickly decay in their graves; they will be where dead people are, far from their homes.

49.16: [So], do not be dismayed when someone becomes rich and the houses where they live become more and more luxurious,
49.17: because when he dies, he will take nothing with him; his wealth will not go with him.
49.18: While [a rich person] is alive, he congratulates himself, and people praise him for being successful,
49.19: but he will [die], joining his ancestors, who will never see daylight again.
49.20: Even if someone is great, that cannot prevent him from dying; he will die, the same as animals do.

50.1: God, the all-powerful one, speaks; he summons all people, from the east to the west.
50.2: His glory shines from Zion [Hill in Jerusalem], an extremely beautiful city.
50.3: Our God comes to us, and he is not silent. A great fire is in front of him, and a storm is around him.
50.4: He comes to judge his people. He shouts to the [angels in] heaven and to [the people on] the earth.
50.5: He says, “Summon those who faithfully [worship] me, those who made an agreement with me by offering sacrifices to me.”
50.6: The [angels in] heaven declare, “God is righteous, and he is the supreme judge.” (Think about that!)
50.7: God says, “My people, listen! You Israeli people, listen, as I, your God, say what you have done that is wrong.
50.8: I am not rebuking you for making sacrifices to me, for the offerings that you completely burn [on the altar].
50.9: But I do not really need [you to sacrifice ] the bulls from your barns and the goats from your pens,
50.10: because all the animals in the forest belong to me, [and all] the cattle on 1,000 hills also belong to me.
50.11: I [own and] know all the birds and all [the creatures ] that move around in the fields.

50.14: The sacrifice [that I really want is that] you thank me and do all that you have promised to do.

50.16: But I say this to the wicked people: ◄Why do you/It does not benefit you at all to► recite my commandments or talk about the agreement that I made with you,

50.21: You did [all] those things, and I did not say anything to you, [so] you thought that I was [a sinner] just like you. But now I rebuke you and accuse you, right in front of you.
50.22: So, all you who have ignored me, pay attention to this, because if you do not, I will tear you to pieces, and there will be no one to rescue you.
50.23: The sacrifice that [truly] honors me is to thank me [for what I have done]; and I will save those who always do the things that I want them to.”

51.1: O God, be merciful to me, because you love me faithfully; because you are very merciful, erase [the record of] the ways that I disobeyed you!
51.2: Make me pure from the wrong things that I have done; make me clean from [the guilt of] my sin.
51.3: [I say that] because I know the ways that I have disobeyed you; I cannot forget them.
51.4: You, you only, are the one that I have [really] sinned against, and you have seen the evil things that I have done. When you say that I am guilty, you are right/correct, and when you judge me, you justly say [that I deserve to be punished].
51.5: I have been a sinner since the day that I was born; [truly], I have been like that since my mother conceived me.
51.6: What you desire is that I desire what is true in order that you [can] teach me how to act wisely.
51.7: Purify me from the guilt of my sins, and [after that happens], I will be clean [in my inner being]; cleanse me, and [then in my inner being] I will be ◄whiter than snow/very clean►.
51.8: Allow/Cause me to be joyful again; you have ◄crushed my spirit/completely discouraged me► ; [but now] let me rejoice [again].
51.9: Do not continue to look at the sins that I have committed; erase the record of the evil things that I have done.
51.10: O God, cause my inner being to be pure. Put new [thoughts ] within me and make me faithful again.
51.11: Do not send me away from you [because of my sin], and do not take your Holy Spirit from me.
51.12: Cause/Allow me to be happy again because of [knowing] that you have freed me [from the guilt of my sin], and make me willing [to obey you].
51.13: If you do that, I will [be able to] teach [other] sinners what you want them to do, and they will repent and begin to obey you.
51.14: O God, you are the one who saves me; forgive me for being guilty of causing someone [who was not my enemy] to die. [When you do that], I will sing joyfully about your being very good and righteous.
51.15: O Yahweh, help me to speak [in order that] I may praise you.
51.16: You are not pleased [only] with the sacrifices [that people bring to you]. If that were [enough to] please you, I would bring you sacrifices. You are not pleased with burnt offerings [alone].
51.17: The sacrifice that you [really] want is for people to be truly humble and sorry [for having sinned]; O God, you will not refuse that kind of sacrifice.
51.18: [O God], be good to [the people who live in] Jerusalem , [and help them] to rebuild the city walls.
51.19: When that happens, [they will bring you] the proper sacrifices, animals that they will completely burn, young bulls that they will burn on your altar, and you will be pleased.

52.1: You people [think that you] are strong and brag about the sins that you have committed, while you plan to harm godly people.
52.2: All during the day you plan to get rid of [others]; what you say [injures others] like a sharp razor , and you are [always] deceiving [others].
52.3: You like [doing what is] evil more than you like doing what is good, and you like telling lies more than you like telling the truth. (Think about that!)
52.4: You who say things to deceive people, you like to say ◄things that hurt people/cruel things►!
52.5: But God will get rid of you forever; he will grab you and drag you from your home and take you away from this world where people are alive. (Think about that!)
52.6: When righteous [people] see that, they will be awestruck, and they will laugh at [what happened to] you, and say,
52.7: “Look [what happened to] the man who would not ask God to protect him; he trusted that his great wealth [would save him]; he trusted in the money that he got by wickedly taking it from others!”
52.8: But I am [secure/safe because I worship] in God’s temple; I am like a [strong] green olive tree. I trust in God, who faithfully loves us forever.
52.9: God, I will always thank you for the things that you have done. As I stand before godly [people], I will proclaim that you are good (OR, the many good [things you have done for us]).

53.1: [Only] foolish people say to themselves, “There is no God!” People who say that are corrupt; they commit terrible sins; there is not one of them who does what is good/right.

53.3: [But] they are all morally corrupt; no one does what is good/right.
53.4: Will all these evil people never learn [what God will do to them]? They act violently toward Yahweh’s people while eating the food that he provides, and they never pray to Yahweh.
53.5: But [some day] those people will become terrified, like they have never been terrified before, because God will cause those who are separated from him to die, and he will [disrespect them by] scattering their bones. They have rejected God, so he will cause them to be [defeated and] completely disgraced.
53.6: I wish/desire that someone from Jerusalem would come and rescue the Israeli [people]! God, when you bless your people again, [all] the Israeli [people, all the descendants of] Jacob, will rejoice.

54.2: God, listen to my prayer; listen to what I say to you,

54.4: But God is the one who helps me; Yahweh defends/protects me [from my enemies].
54.5: He will cause the evil things that they want to do to me to happen to them instead; because he faithfully [does what he promises], he will get rid of them.
54.6: Yahweh, I will gladly give an offering to you because I want to, and I will thank you , for you are good [to me];
54.7: you have rescued me from all my troubles, and I have seen that you have defeated my enemies.

55.2: Listen to me, and answer me, because I am overwhelmed by [all] my troubles.
55.3: My enemies cause me to be terrified; wicked people oppress me. They cause me to have great troubles; they are angry with me, and they hate me.

55.8: I would quickly find a shelter from [my enemies] [who are like] a strong wind and rainstorm.”

55.11: They destroy [things] everywhere. They oppress and defraud [people] in the ◄marketplaces/public squares►.
55.12: If it were an enemy who was making fun of me, I could endure it. If it were someone who hates me, who despises me, I could hide from him.
55.13: But it is someone who is just like me, my companion, someone who was my friend [who is doing this to me].
55.14: We previously had many good talks together; we walked around together in God’s temple.
55.15: I desire/hope that my enemies will die suddenly; while they are still young, cause them to go down to the place where the dead people are. They they think evil things.
55.16: But I [will] ask Yahweh, [my] God, to help me, and he will save me.
55.17: [Each] morning and [each] noontime and [each] evening I tell him what I am concerned about, and I moan, and he hears my voice.
55.18: I have [very] many enemies, but he will rescue me and bring me back safely from the battles that I fight.
55.19: God is the one who has ruled everything forever, and he will listen to me. He will cause my enemies to be [defeated and] disgraced, because they do not change their evil behavior and they do not revere God. (Think about that!)
55.20: My companion, [whom I mentioned previously], betrayed his friends and broke the agreement that he made with them.
55.21: What he said was [easy to listen to, like] butter [is easy to swallow] , but in his inner being he hated people; his words were [soothing] like [olive] oil, [but they hurt people like] sharp swords do .
55.22: Put your troubles in Yahweh’s hands, and he will take care of you; he will never allow righteous [people] to experience disasters.
55.23: God, you will cause murderers and liars to die before they have lived half as long as they expect to live; but [as for me], I will trust in you.

56.1: God, be merciful to me because men have harassed me; all day my enemies pursue me.
56.2: My enemies harass me all day long; there are many of them who proudly attack me.
56.3: But whenever I am afraid, I trust in you.
56.4: God, I praise/thank you because you do what you have promised; I trust in you, and then I am not afraid. Ordinary humans certainly cannot harm me!
56.5: All day long my enemies claim that I said things that I did not say (OR, try to destroy what I am doing); they are always thinking of ways to harm me.
56.6: In order to cause trouble for me, they hide and watch everything that I do, waiting for [an opportunity] to kill me .
56.7: So, God, punish them for the wicked things that they are doing; show that you are angry by defeating those people!
56.8: You have counted [all] the times that I have been wandering alone/distressed; [it is as though] you have put [all] my tears in a bottle [in order that you can see how much I have cried]. [You have counted my tears and written] the number in your book.
56.9: When I call out to you, [my] God, my enemies will be defeated; I know that will happen, because you are fighting for me.
56.10: I praise/thank you that you do what you have promised; Yahweh, I [will always] praise you for that .
56.11: I trust in you, and as a result, I will not be afraid. I know that humans cannot really harm me!
56.12: I will bring to you the offering that I promised; I will bring an offering to you to thank you,
56.13: because you have rescued me from being killed; you have kept me from stumbling. As a result, I will continue to live in your presence in the light that [shines on those who are still] alive (OR, in the light that [enables people to] live).

57.1: God, be merciful to me! Act mercifully toward me because I come to you to protect me. I ask you to protect me [like little birds are protected under their mother’s] wings until the storm/danger is ended.
57.2: God, you who are greater than all other gods, I cry out to you, the one who enables me to do all that you desire.
57.3: You will answer me from heaven and rescue me, but you will cause those who oppress me to be [defeated and] disgraced! (Think about that!) God will [always] faithfully love me and ◄will be faithful/will do what he promises►.
57.4: [Sometimes] I am surrounded by [my enemies who are like] lions that [kill] humans; [they are like] lions that chew with their teeth [animals that they kill]; but my enemies have spears and arrows, not teeth; and [the false things that] they say [hurt people as much as] sharp swords [hurt people] .
57.5: God, show in the heavens that you are very great! And show your glory to people all over the earth!

57.7: God, I have complete confidence in you. I will sing to you, and I will praise you while I sing.

57.10: because your faithful love for us is [as great as the distance from the earth] to the sky, and because your ◄faithfulness/faithfully doing what you promise► is [as great as the distance] up to the clouds .
57.11: God, show in the heavens that you are very great! And show your glory [to people] all over the earth!

58.1: When you mighty men speak, you never say what is right; you never decide things about people justly !

73.1: God truly is good to [us] Israeli people, to those who totally want to do all that God desires.

75.1: We give thanks to you; our God, we thank you. You are close to us, and we proclaim to others the wonderful things that you have done [for us].

78.1: My friends, listen to what I am going to teach you; pay careful attention to what I say.

140.9: [Do not allow] my enemies to ◄become proud/defeat me►; cause the evil things that they say they will do to me to happen to them, [instead].

140.11: Do not allow those who slander others to succeed; cause evil things to happen to violent men and destroy them!
140.12: Yahweh, I know that you defend those who are oppressed, and that you do what is just/fair for those who are needy/poor.

141.1: Yahweh, I call out to you; [please] help me quickly! Listen to me when I am calling to you.

141.5: It is all right if righteous people strike/hit me or rebuke me because they are trying to act kindly toward me [to teach me to do what is right], but I do not want wicked [people] to [honor me by] anointing my head with [olive] oil; I am always praying [that you will punish them because of] the wicked deeds [that they do].

141.7: Like a log that is split and cut into small pieces , their shattered bones will be scattered [on the ground] near [other] graves.

141.9: [It is as though] people have set traps for me; protect me from falling into those traps, [It is as though] they have spread nets to catch me; keep me from being caught in those nets.

142.1: Yahweh, I cry out to you; I plead [with you to help me].

143.1: Yahweh, hear me while I pray to you! Because you are righteous and because you faithfully do what you have promised, listen to what I am pleading that you [do for me].

143.8: [Every] morning cause me to remember that you faithfully love [me], because I trust in you. I ◄pray/send my prayers up ► to you; show me what I should do.

143.11: Yahweh, restore me when I am close to dying, as you promised to do. Because you are righteous/good, rescue me from my troubles/difficulties!

144.1: I praise Yahweh, who is [like an overhanging] rock [under which I] ◄[get refuge/am protected]►! He trains my hands so that I can use them to fight battles; he trains my fingers so that I can [shoot arrows in a war].

144.8: who [always] tell lies. [Even in a courtroom where they swear to tell the truth] they tell lies.

I wish/hope that [there will not be a time when the people in] our streets cry out in distress [because foreign armies are invading].

145.1: My God and King, I will proclaim that you are very great/glorious; I will praise you now and forever.

146.1: Praise Yahweh! With my whole inner being I will praise Yahweh.

147.1: Praise Yahweh! It is good to sing to praise our God. It is a delightful thing to do and the right thing to do.

148.1: Praise Yahweh! Praise him, from up in heaven; praise him from way up in the sky!
